thread:
alex.m: Heads up — my docs PR for the IAM key rotation walkthrough is ready but blocked. Need a quick runtime confirmation + a small SDK snippet for the example. Also the docs preview CI is failing because it can't read the demo secret.

alex.m: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4123 (preview link in CI).

ben.d: I saw the preview error — docs-ci-bot is throwing `MISSING_SECRET: REDWOOD_DEMO_KEY`. That's the preview-only secret we use for snippet rendering. Can you add a placeholder in the PR settings?

alex.m: Yeah I removed the real key. Wanted to use an env var placeholder but CI still needs a dummy value. Can someone from infra add a demo secret scoped to the docs repo?

docs-ci-bot: deploy-preview failed — Missing required secret: REDWOOD_DEMO_KEY. See https://internal.tools/docs-ci/secrets for how to add.

sara.r: Quick product/runtime note: rotation endpoint returns a short-lived token (ttl=300s) and the gateway accepts either `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or `x-api-key: <token>` headers, but only bearer supports scoped IAM roles in the current rollout. For docs we should show the bearer flow as the canonical example.

anna.p: +1 to bearer example. Also callout: when rotating keys you need to wait ~10s for the old KV to flush across regional caches if you call immediately — we had a pager once. Suggest adding a tiny note under "consistency window".

ben.d: For the SDK snippet, keep it language-agnostic but include JS and Python examples. Proposed JS snippet (inline) — put this in the thread for review:
```js
// rotate and use new token (JS)
const resp = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/iam/rotate', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + process.env.ADMIN_KEY } });
const { token } = await resp.json();
const out = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'Hello' }) });
```

ben.d: Python snippet too, short and similar. Add both into the PR under /examples/auth.

alex.m: Thanks — that JS looks good. Two quick asks: 1) confirm whether we should still show `x-api-key` as an alternate header in a one-line note, 2) can someone add the dummy REDWOOD_DEMO_KEY to CI so I can get the preview link for reviewers?

sara.r: 1) Yes show `x-api-key` as an alternate one-liner but mark bearer as recommended. 2) I'm not infra but can ping infra. @ben.d can you add a short note in the PR that says "preview requires REDWOOD_DEMO_KEY (dummy allowed)" so infra knows it is safe?

ben.d: Done — added PR comment and example config in the PR description.

anna.p: I'll file a tiny docs follow-up to add the consistency-window note and reference the runtime blog post.

docs-ci-bot: Secret REDWOOD_DEMO_KEY added to repo by infra-bot. Triggering new preview build...

docs-ci-bot: deploy-preview succeeded — preview available at https://preview.docs.internal/redwood/4123

alex.m: Preview looks good. Runtime answers future-proof the text. Assigning reviewers: @sara.r for runtime confirmation, @ben.d for SDK snippet check. Can we aim to merge after approvals today?

sara.r: I'm good with the new wording and bearer-first approach. One tiny nit on phrasing for the consistency window — suggest "may take up to 10s to propagate".

ben.d: SDK snippet lgtm. I added a tiny lint fix for the JS sample (use fetch polyfill note).

alex.m: Great — merging when both approve. Thanks everyone :rocket:
